text:
Alex (partnerships): quick sync request — OrionSoft sent a few duplicate usage callbacks this morning to the marketplace webhook. can we align on ack semantics + retry window?

Kevin [OrionSoft]: hey — saw those. we had a transient 502 from your ingest and our lib retried 3x. wondering what you expect for idempotency keys so we don't double-bill.

Maria (billing): @Kevin we key by (partner_event_id, product_id, hour_bucket). if you resend within the same hour we treat as de-dup by event id. what's your generated id today?

Kevin [OrionSoft]: we were using uuid v4 per usage batch, but our router re-sent with a new uuid on retry. we can switch to stable ids if you need.

Tariq (eng-platform): shortterm: we can accept a partner_reference header and use that for de-dupe if present. longterm: prefer idempotency param in payload. also want to clarify retry policy — are you ok with 3 retries spaced backoff up to 2m?

Alex (partnerships): goals: (1) no duplicate billing (2) clear SLA for announcements (3) minimal code changes for partners.

Kevin [OrionSoft]: 3 retries up to 2m is fine. switching to stable id generation is doable but will roll next week. can you tolerate a short backfill window if we need to re-send missing events?

Maria (billing): backfill is fine but must include original timestamps and partner_reference. our reconciliation job accepts backfills up to 7 days with a special flag to avoid immediate charge changes.

Tariq (eng-platform): technical asks for Kevin: add header X-Partner-Event-ID (stable), include customer_entitlement_id in payload, and respond 202 when accepted. If duplicate detected, respond 200 with body {"status":"duplicate"}.

Kevin [OrionSoft]: ok — we'll add X-Partner-Event-ID and keep uuid stable across retries. can you post the sample payload and exact response codes?

Alex (partnerships): sample below. @Tariq @Maria please confirm we can share this with OrionSoft and include in partner integration doc.

ingest-bot: deploy finished: marketplace-ingest v2.14 -> prod (hash: ab12cd).

Tariq (eng-platform): sample payload:
```json
{
  "partner_event_id": "orion-20260321-0001",
  "entitlement_id": "ent-12345",
  "usage_units": 120,
  "window_start": "2026-03-21T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-03-21T00:59:59Z"
}
```

Tariq (eng-platform): sample responses:
- 202 Accepted -> {"status":"accepted","ingest_id":"ing-987"}
- 200 OK -> {"status":"duplicate","existing_ingest_id":"ing-987"}
- 4xx -> client error (do not retry)

Maria (billing): and include header X-Partner-Timestamp for origin time zone reconciliation.

Kevin [OrionSoft]: perfect. we'll target rollout Monday (2026-03-30) and will notify you when feature flag is flipped. any risk to your reconciliation if we start with partial stable ids?

Maria (billing): partial is ok as long as you include partner_event_id and partner_timestamp. we will mark partial events as provisional until stable ids arrive.

Alex (partnerships): thanks everyone. i'll put this in the partner integration checklist and send a short Slack note to the SI channel once Orion confirms. :thumbsup:

Kevin [OrionSoft]: thanks — will ping when PR merges.
